purpose: bounded repeated-event engineering pilot, not final inference or scope selection
seed_rule: base + workload_index*10000 + replicate*10; time=s, K=s+1, field=s+2, anchor=(s+2) XOR 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15
matching: same time seed at every profile; at equal event rate arrival times are identical across profiles. Rate is an independent scenario parameter, not fitted from pilot outcomes
time_process: homogeneous Poisson, exponential gaps, t in [0,10000)
ordering: arrivals in [o,o+1) projected before conditional prediction o, ordered by arrival, every event applied; all unconditional controls retained
location: field selected by B_j / B_exposed; within-field uniform valid consecutive K-bit anchor
K2_boundary_bias: endpoint hit probability 1/(B_j-1), interior 2/(B_j-1), conditional on K=2 and field j
reset: one warmup snapshot restore per independent run, no restore between events
single_event_recovery_time: not estimated by this interacting-event pilot
statistical_unit: complete independent event-stream run, stratified by workload/model/rate; four repetitions insufficient for ranking or reliable CI
split: existing Stage0 design windows only; reserved seed block is not an input holdout; disjoint input windows remain to be locked before final selection/evaluation
rate_justification: T=10000 and lambda*T=0,0.1,1,10 test zero/sparse/repeating operation. This is an implementation smoke grid, not a measured environment rate or a recovery-time-based main experiment
